interpretation.label: h1_weakened_training_reduced_readout_consequence
interpretation.summary: C1neg: the consequence-trained readout changes E3's top preference LESS than the same substrate's frozen-init readout, beyond chance and by at least 0.05, on 4 of 7 ready seeds; mean paired DV -0.0837. Trained pair divergent above the floor on 2 ready seeds, init pair on 7 (C2 annotates: trained pair collapsed). Consequence training under an open loop made the readout LESS argmin-consequential, not more: H1 WEAKENED, in the direction opposite to its prediction, as operationalised by this lineage's training procedure. WHY is for the autopsy -- trained_head_flip_fraction and |bias| are recorded as its inputs.
interpretation.combination_rule: Adjudicated over the READY seeds only (per-seed readiness gates; MIN_READY_SEEDS=4, absolute). PASS iff C1 (significant AND >= MIN_EFFECT_OF_INTEREST=0.05 per seed on a seed majority, mean >= it). Among FAILs: C1neg (the mirror) -> weakens; else C4 (two-sided equivalence within +/-0.05 on EVERY ready seed, |mean| < it) -> weakens; else unknown. C1/C1neg/C4 are mutually exclusive per seed by construction. C3 refines a PASS; C2 annotates a FAIL. SEED_MAJORITY=4 is absolute, never a fraction of the realised ready count.

criteria.name: C1_trained_over_init_paired_exact
criteria.definition: per seed: P[Bin(b+c,1/2) >= b] < alpha AND (b-c)/n >= effect_floor; passes on >= threshold seeds AND mean DV over ready seeds >= floor

criteria.name: C1neg_init_over_trained_paired_exact
criteria.routes: FAIL -> weakens (training reduced the readout's argmin consequence)

criteria.name: C4_two_sided_equivalence_all_ready_seeds
criteria.definition: per seed: -m < LB95 and UB95 < m (m=0.050); passes only on EVERY ready seed with |mean DV| < m, and only when neither C1 nor C1neg fired

criteria.name: C2_trained_pair_itself_divergent
criteria.note: implied by C1 given R5 (pass-1 red-team F2-A); annotates FAIL labels only

criteria.name: C3_fresh_seed_reproduces
criteria.threshold_not_applicable: applies only on a C1 PASS; records which clearing seeds are fresh
criteria.note: refines a PASS label only; recorded applies:false on any FAIL

PASS iff C1 (significant AND >= MIN_EFFECT_OF_INTEREST=0.05 per seed on a seed majority, mean >= it). Among FAILs: C1neg (the mirror) -> weakens; else C4 (two-sided equivalence within +/-0.05 on EVERY ready seed, |mean| < it) -> weakens; else unknown.
